tides.harbour module

The tides.harbour module reads tide gauges.

TideClock

class tides.harbour.TideClock(harbour, units='m')

The TideClock class follows the tides of one harbour. Readings come from a Gauge.

Note

Times are reported in UTC.

clock = TideClock("brest")
clock.next_high_tide()
next_high_tide(after: datetime | None = None)

The next_high_tide method finds the next high tide. It never looks back.

Parameter

Description

after

Optional datetime. Search from this moment; defaults to now.
Returns:

A datetime in UTC.

property units

The unit of every reported height.

nearest_harbour

tides.harbour.nearest_harbour(x, y)

Finds the harbour closest to a coordinate. See TideClock.
